Where the</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">signatures diverge — conv2d, matmul program</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">configs — the swap does not work and the op needs</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">real per-op handling instead.</font>' style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eef2f6;strokeColor=#94a3b8;fontColor=#0f172a;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=4;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="272" width="480" height="250" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="status" value="<b>Does it run? style="font-size:9px">3. does it actually run? see below</font><br>&nbsp;<br><font style="font-size:9px">Only (3) counts, and (1)+(2) being green is why</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">'add is unmapped' is the wrong diagnosis.</font><br>&nbsp;<br><font style="font-size:9px">Driven from tt-metal directly, the Quasar add</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">PASSES: 4/4 resnet50 residual-add shapes on</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">craq-sim, bf16, TILE, HEIGHT_SHARDED in L1,</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">8x4 = 32 cores, fused RELU.</font><br>&nbsp;<br><font style="font-size:9px">Driven from forge it wedges: f32, DRAM,</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">INTERLEAVED, 1x1 grid. srcA/srcB reach</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">valid=1 unpack=1 matrix=0 — operands delivered,</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">math unit never consumes them.</font>" svg.text: How one ONNX Add is mapped onto Quasar
Compilation is arch-neutral: the same ttnn.add reaches the runtime for every target. A single branch then picks the
implementation — and on Quasar the mainline one is refused, not slow.
